text:
Type: metal counter stool, set of four
Use: seating at a counter or kitchen island; kitchen, dining room
Style: industrial, retro, minimalist
Materials: glossy powder-coated steel, rubber foot caps
Colors: bright white
Shape: backless square seat with a hand slot, four tapered splayed legs, low crossbars, stackable, compact and light
Feel: clean, casual, utilitarian
Goes with: white or grey kitchens, wood counters, black or chrome accents; industrial or modern rooms

product.name: Pioneer Square BT3503-24-GR Counter Stool, 24", Gray
product.description: 24-inch counter-height stool (set of 4) for indoor or outdoor use; ideal for a shop, kitchen, game room, or patio Made of durable metal with a grey powder-coat finish; sleek industrial style offers contemporary good looks Stackable design for space-saving storage; plastic caps on cross brace protect finish from scratches when stacked; comfortable foot rest Square-shaped seat with supportive brace and drain hole; non-marring rubber feet prevent sliding and protect floors Measures 16 by 16 by 24 inches (LxWxH); seat measures 12 by 12 inches (LxW); no assembly needed
